blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of V27 sit and crouch renders shows the center lap still fails to cover the raised thighs: broad shorts panels remain exposed, while overskirt fabric lifts and hangs behind/between the legs. The broader thigh-follow field does not create continuous lap coverage.

V27 front, three-quarter, and side views retain coarse triangular faceting across the skirt, uneven folded side edges, and a stiff segmented hem. The center field does not materially improve overall surface continuity.
Direct back-view inspection still cannot distinguish the rear adjustment tab and buckle from the jacket/skirt silhouette.
Authored UV mapping remains missing; no inspected view constitutes a UV layout.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
